# Setup Script Template

Use this as a scaffold to generate `new-mac-setup.sh` from the Phase 1 audit:
- Only include sections for tools actually detected on the old Mac.
- The user runs the script in Terminal on the new Mac. It asks for their password (Homebrew, Xcode Command Line Tools).
- The script does **not** write `.zshrc`; Phase 7 copies the real one.
- A failing package doesn't abort the run. Failures are collected and printed at the end.

```bash
#!/bin/zsh
# =============================================================================
# New Mac Setup Script
# Generated by /alb:mac-migration
# Run this on the NEW Mac: zsh ~/new-mac-setup.sh
# =============================================================================

failed=()

echo "=============================="
echo " New Mac Setup"
echo "=============================="

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. HOMEBREW
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "\n[1] Installing Homebrew..."
if ! command -v brew &>/dev/null; then
  /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
fi
if [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ]; then
  eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
else
  eval "$(/usr/local/bin/brew shellenv)"
fi
export HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1
# Make Homebrew available in every new shell. On an Intel -> Apple Silicon move,
# the old .zprofile has no such line, because /usr/local/bin was already on PATH.
brew_line="eval \"\$($(command -v brew) shellenv)\""
grep -qF "$brew_line" ~/.zprofile 2>/dev/null || echo "$brew_line" >> ~/.zprofile

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HOMEBREW TAPS (only taps detected on old Mac)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "\n[2] Adding taps..."
taps=(
  # mongodb/brew
  # shivammathur/php
  # stripe/stripe-cli
)
for t in $taps; do brew tap "$t" || failed+=("tap:$t"); done

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HOMEBREW PACKAGES (from `brew leaves --installed-on-request` and `brew list --cask`)
# Arrays allow one package per line with comments in between. Never use
# `\` line continuations for package lists: a comment line ends the command.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "\n[3] Installing packages..."
formulae=(
  git
  curl
  wget
)
casks=(
  # visual-studio-code
  # claude-code
)
for f in $formulae; do brew install "$f" || failed+=("$f"); done
for c in $casks; do brew install --cask "$c" || failed+=("cask:$c"); done

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SHELL FRAMEWORK (only if detected; keeps the .zshrc Phase 7 will copy)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# echo "\n[4] Installing oh-my-zsh..."
# if [ ! -d "$HOME/.oh-my-zsh" ]; then
#   RUNZSH=no KEEP_ZSHRC=yes CHSH=no sh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh)" || failed+=("oh-my-zsh")
# fi

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. NODE (only if nvm detected)
# PROFILE=/dev/null stops the nvm installer from editing .zshrc
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# echo "\n[5] Installing nvm and Node..."
# if [ ! -d "$HOME/.nvm" ]; then
#   curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh | PROFILE=/dev/null bash
# fi
# export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
# [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"

# ADD DETECTED NODE VERSIONS:
# nvm install 20 || failed+=("node 20")
# nvm install 22 || failed+=("node 22")
# nvm alias default 22

# Global npm packages (for each version that had them)
# npm install -g yarn pnpm || failed+=("npm globals")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. PYTHON (only if pyenv detected)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# echo "\n[6] Installing Python..."
# brew install pyenv pyenv-virtualenv || failed+=("pyenv")
# eval "$(pyenv init -)"
# pyenv install 3.11.11 || failed+=("python 3.11.11")
# pyenv global 3.11.11
# pip install --upgrade pip && pip install requests || failed+=("pip globals")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. RUBY (only if rbenv detected)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# echo "\n[7] Installing Ruby..."
# brew install rbenv ruby-build || failed+=("rbenv")
# eval "$(rbenv init -)"
# rbenv install 3.2.0 || failed+=("ruby 3.2.0")
# rbenv global 3.2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. PHP (only if detected; use shivammathur tap for older versions)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# brew install shivammathur/php/php@8.2 || failed+=("php@8.2")
# brew install shivammathur/php/php@7.4 || failed+=("php@7.4")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. RUST (only if detected)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# --no-modify-path: Phase 7 copies the real shell config, which already sets up cargo
# curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path || failed+=("rustup")
# source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
# cargo install ripgrep || failed+=("cargo installs")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. JAVA / OTHER LANGUAGES (add as detected — usually brew formulae in step 3)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# openjdk@17, go, elixir, kotlin … belong in the formulae array above.
# flutter belongs in the casks array.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. DATABASES — start services
# Same or newer major version than the old Mac. Keg-only formulae
# (postgresql@16, mysql@8.4) are not on PATH: Phase 7's copied .zshrc may
# need e.g.  export PATH="$(brew --prefix postgresql@16)/bin:$PATH"
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "\n[11] Starting services..."
services=(
  # postgresql@16
  # mysql@8.4          (not plain `mysql`, which is 9.x)
  # mongodb/brew/mongodb-community
  # redis
)
for s in $services; do brew services start "$s" || failed+=("service:$s"); done

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DONE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "\n=============================="
if (( ${#failed} )); then
  echo " Setup finished with ${#failed} failure(s):"
  printf '   - %s\n' "${failed[@]}"
  echo " Fix these, then re-run this script (it skips what's already installed)."
else
  echo " Setup complete!"
fi
echo "=============================="
```
